prompt:
Scene:
A top-down square photograph of the interior editorial spread of the same zine from the reference. The grey newsprint paper tone, drum-line streaks, and overall photocopy grain are identical. A pair of scissors rests near the bottom-right edge just inside frame as if the maker had only just stepped away.

Subject:
The editorial inside spread is a dense two-page essay. The left page features a column of photocopied typewriter text fragments taped over each other at slight angles, two cut-out portraits roughly cropped into ovals, and marker underlines in tomato red. The right page holds a torn graph fragment with hand-redrawn lines over it in blue ballpoint, a blocky hand-drawn diagram with arrows, and a small rubber-stamp date smear.

Important details:
Preserve exact identity established by the reference: same grey newsprint, same drum-line grain, same highlighter yellow, ballpoint blue, tomato red marker, same scissor-fray edges, same glue halo style. Only composition and content differ. Typewriter text must be photocopy-aged, edges blurred. The rubber-stamp date smear must be real ink, not vector.

Use case:
Series image 2 of 4 · the editorial spread of the same zine, continuing the paper and hand.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no vector graphs, no clean edges, no uniform color fills, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio.
